overview.headline: How open market operations implement monetary policy and guide the federal funds rate

keyPoints.point: Open market operations are the purchase and sale of securities to implement monetary policy.
keyPoints.quote: the purchase and sale of securities in the open market by a central bank--are a key tool used by the Federal Reserve

keyPoints.point: The federal funds rate is the interest rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances overnight to each other.
keyPoints.quote: the federal funds rate--the interest rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances to other depository institutions overnight

keyPoints.point: From 2008 through 2014 the Federal Reserve expanded holdings of longer term securities to put downward pressure on longer term interest rates.
keyPoints.quote: From the end of 2008 through October 2014, the Federal Reserve greatly expanded its holding of longer-term securities through open market purchases

keyPoints.point: Standing repo operations limit upward pressure and provide a ceiling on rates to support monetary policy implementation.
keyPoints.quote: SRP operations limit upward pressure and help provide a ceiling on rates to support the monetary policy implementation

keyTerms.gloss: purchase and sale of securities by a central bank to implement monetary policy
keyTerms.quote: Open market operations (OMOs)--the purchase and sale of securities in the open market by a central bank

keyTerms.gloss: interest rate for overnight lending of reserve balances between depository institutions
keyTerms.quote: the federal funds rate--the interest rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances

keyTerms.gloss: supply of funds that depository institutions hold and can lend overnight
keyTerms.quote: adjust the supply of reserve balances so as to keep the federal funds rate

keyTerms.gloss: supplementary policy tool used to help control the federal funds rate and keep it in target range
keyTerms.quote: overnight reverse repurchase agreements (ON RRPs)--a type of OMO--as a supplementary policy tool

keyTerms.gloss: operations against eligible securities that provide a ceiling on rates
keyTerms.quote: Federal Reserve has conducted domestic standing repo (SRP) operations against eligible securities
